author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell jokes about refusing to believe in numbers, dates or time, arguing that if you’re living in eternity, none of it really matters anyway. From being late for flights to the way companies treat you beautifully when they want your money, he turns the joke into a deeper point: the world can’t solve your problems, so don’t conform to its patterns — renew your mind instead.

title: Time isn't real...

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell argues that it shouldn’t matter which side of a political argument you’re on — whether you’re concerned about national sovereignty or Palestinian rights, people should still be able to speak freely and be treated fairly. He calls for truth, justice, innocent until proven guilty and free speech, before warning that when people feel ignored and trapped by centralized systems, frustration can inevitably turn into direct action.
